question_text: A 67-year-old man is seen on the surgical floor after a transplant procedure. The previous day, the patient had a renal transplant from a matched donor. He is currently recovering and doing well. The patient has a past medical history of IV drug use, diabetes mellitus, oral cold sores, hypertension, renal failure, and dyslipidemia. The patient's current medications include lisinopril, atorvastain, insulin, and aspirin. Prior to the procedure, he was also on dialysis. The patient is started on cyclosporine. The patient successfully recovers over the next few days. Which of the following medications should be started in this patient?
